def factor_intraday_minus_overnight_ewm(df):
    """Directional pressure: intraday return minus overnight return, exponentially smoothed."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"])
    pressure = intraday_ret - overnight_ret
    factor = pressure.ewm(span=10, adjust=False).mean()
    factor.name = "factor_intraday_minus_overnight_ewm"
    return factor
description: Intraday return minus overnight return measures the directional conviction of intraday traders relative to the overnight gap. A positive value indicates that during the trading session, prices moved further in the same direction as the open gap, suggesting persistent buying (or selling) pressure. Exponential smoothing with span 10 reduces noise while preserving the underlying pressure signal. This factor aligns with AgentOrderImbalance's focus on inferring directional pressure from OHLCV behavior.
